name: Motorville
old_description: We take pride in getting customers the parts they need in a timely fashion and at a price they can afford. Customer satisfaction is a cornerstone of our business.
about:
Motorville operates from Lenexa, Kansas, as a family-owned distributor in the high-performance automotive aftermarket. The company has served the industry for over four decades, building a reputation as an authorized dealer for hundreds of performance brands.

The company does not manufacture parts; instead, it stocks and distributes components from brands such as Renegade, Comp Cams, Howards, ARP, Melling, Eagle, Edelbrock, Fel Pro, MSD, Energy Suspension, Elgin, and Mahle Motorsport. Its online platform provides real-time inventory access and a line card for dealers and retail customers. The staff brings a combined 120-plus years of sales and technical experience to support product selection and order fulfillment.

Motorville primarily serves the high-performance automotive aftermarket, supplying dealers, repair shops, and enthusiasts building or modifying vehicles. Its dealer program invites other businesses to become authorized resellers, extending the reach of the brands it carries.

The company emphasizes timely delivery at affordable prices and positions customer satisfaction as a cornerstone of its operation. Leadership cites the depth of staff experience and a passion for automotive performance as key differentiators.
